links.outcome: Exact-code F1 of code-set generation with vs without hybrid biomedical retrieval grounding
links.effect: Hybrid RAG improved aggregate F1 only for Qwen; increased GPT-5.5 RxNorm F1 from 0.320 to 0.909; did not consistently improve exact-code performance.
links.quote: Hybrid biomedical RAG improved aggregate F1 only for Qwen but increased GPT-5.5 RxNorm F1 from 0.320 to 0.909.

links.outcome: Micro-F1 of generated code sets before vs after deterministic terminology verification
links.effect: Micro-F1 rose from 0.254 before verification to 0.505 after final verification and expansion; existence check removed 2,594 false-positive codes, acceptance filtering 952 more.
links.quote: In staged verifier ablation, micro-F1 increased from 0.254 before verification to 0.505 after final verification and expansion.

unlisted_practices: Terminology-guided code family expansion to increase recall (increased recall but generally reduced precision)

screen.practice: deterministic terminology verification and retrieval grounding of LLM outputs
screen.reason: The study benchmarks LLM agent pipelines for clinical code-set generation and tests deployment safeguards/practices including biomedical RAG and deterministic terminology verification/filtering.

primary.practice: retrieval-augmented generation and deterministic terminology verification filtering
